positions.name: Fiserv
positions.catalyst: Reuters reported overnight that Fiserv is exploring a sale of its STAR debit network, with talks involving JPMorgan, Bank of America, Wells Fargo and Principal — a concrete value-unlock step under public pressure from activist Jana Partners. Stock +5.2% pre-market (54.45 vs 51.78 close), rebounding off multi-year lows.
positions.driver: Fresh company-specific catalyst fully orthogonal to today's global AI-chip rout (KOSPI -4.9% circuit breaker, Samsung -6.9%, Nasdaq futures -0.9%, Dow futures up on value rotation). Beaten-down low-beta payments name with activist follow-through potential; +5.2% pre-market is not extended, and deep liquidity gives a clean stop.
positions.risks: Catalyst is an 'exploring sale' press report, not a signed deal — pop can fade if the company doesn't confirm; broader tape is risk-off and an ugly open could drag everything. Stop 6% below entry at 51.18, just under yesterday's close.
